title: Steam Deck Offline Sync Gap
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steamdeck:session
| stats max(_time) as last_sync by device
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_sync)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Steam Deck session sync logs telemetry to monitor how long devices have gone without syncing sessions in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for offline-play gaps before progress or telemetry goes missing, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Steam Deck session sync logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Device table of hours since last sync.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long devices have gone without syncing sessions so you can spot offline-play gaps before progress or telemetry goes missing before it becomes annoying.
